description: Withdraw a question asked in error or overtaken by events. Kept in the graph, not deleted. 🛑 THIS IS NOT HOW YOU FIX BAD WORDING, AND THERE IS NO TOOL THAT IS: a Question records WHAT WAS ASKED, and its answer was given to those exact words. Name it by the `gap_id` it was asked about or by its own `question_id` (one asked with ask_question has no gap). Ask for this to retract a question.

echo.description: What the reply carries. `receipt` (the default) names the node, echoes each stored value of at most 200 characters, gives longer ones by size, and names the snapshot that keeps anything a revise replaced. `node` returns the whole stored node and every prior value.

gap_id.description:
The question to withdraw: the `gap_id` it was asked ABOUT, or — for a
question asked with `ask_question`, which no gap stands behind — its
own `question_id`, as `open_questions` carries both. Either names it.

name: withdraw_question
title: Withdraw a Question
